direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; FactoryStage at least 55vw and 60vh, no page scroll, only inspector and task lists scroll internally
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary #A8F04A on #050705, one per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text, preserving the required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on a real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible focus ring on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail generated from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, never conflating their controls or status; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge the 120 vs 80 mismatch tracks and DOES NOT MATCH label; move the opening-story logo block so it does not compete with the inspector header at 1366x768.
Refit JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 labels inside the stage; 40 parts and 30 parts should read at a glance without leaning on the inspector.
Add a visible focus ring and aria-current to Step 01 and make each SVG node keyboard reachable with its held status announced.
Separate pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity into their own labelled group above, and keep Investigate as a distinct evidence task below; never share one status line between them.
Enlarge the route selector to a 40px target and show the chosen route, offline state, and next action in one status sentence.
Dim the unchanged factory stage slightly and add a SAMPLE marker on the stage title so pre-selection state is not read as a live result.
Keep the typed consent form tied to the selected path: show plan name, exact phrase, character count, and disabled Accept state adjacent in one fieldset.
Align 83h/$0.00, 35h/$3,115.00 and 17.5h/$3,202.50 in tabular columns and mark the selected card with pattern plus text, not colour alone.
Prevent the GuideStrip subtitle wrapping to two lines at 1366x768 by shortening it to one verb-led instruction.
Make PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL unmissable on each task card and in the DecisionBar centre status; keep the count at 0 tracked until approval.
Enlarge the neon recovery route labels MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts, 40 via CELL-MILL-1 and 30 via CELL-MILL-1 where they cross machine edges.
Give the task list its own internal scroll cue and 36px minimum row targets; keep Decline proposal as a clear secondary text action.
Label the CELL-MILL-2 dashed outline explicitly as PREVIEW - not applied, distinct from the red stopped state used after the shock is applied.
Show the consequence beside the selector: will invalidate Use verified substitute, with the affected tracked count stated before Apply second shock.
Enlarge the machine selector to 40px and add a focus ring that remains visible against the raised panel.
Preserve red only on stopped CELL-MILL-2: cross-hatch, outline and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; remove any red tint from the mismatch bar area that implies a second stopped element.
Keep pre-flight nonce/identity health separate from the Reinvestigate recovery evidence action, with separate headings, statuses and buttons.
State 3 to 2 feasible paths and CONSTRAINED - capacity changed directly on the affected option card in the stage, not only in the top banner.
Make the constrained Split card non-selectable with a hatched pattern, em-dash metrics and the reason Split requires at least two online compatible cells.
Anchor the revised typed consent form to the revised plan identifier and show PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED in the DecisionBar until the exact phrase matches.
Reduce inspector vertical scroll at 1366x768 by tightening comparison card padding while keeping 13/19 body text.
Split the inspector into two labelled groups: Prior tracked work - 3 BLOCKED remains visible, and Revised proposal - PROPOSED untracked until approval; do not merge their counts.
State Approved revised plan - replacement tasks await approval in both the board header and DecisionBar centre so coexistence is explicit.
Enlarge blocked-task reason text and give the collapsed prior-work disclosure a 40px target with aria-expanded.
Refit the Before-After panel so 70 parts, 35h accepted plan and 48h saving are fully visible without internal clipping at 1366x768.
Group Seal encrypted packet, Verify ledger and Retain independent checkpoint as three separate steps with separate statuses; never imply one action completes another.
Move the primary Verify ledger action only into the DecisionBar or only into the inspector, eliminating the duplicate primary in one viewport.
Replace the active-looking Recovery complete primary with a sealed terminal status in the DecisionBar; keep Back as the only action unless a new scenario is offered.
Show packet sealed, 18 events, revised plan accepted and CELL-MILL-2 offline retained as a four-line proof summary linked to the SVG state.
Ensure the masked passphrase field is read-only in the complete state and its Complete - current ledger checks align in tabular rows.
